---
title: "xusave"
---

## Description

Keep needed variables, apply sorting order, apply dataset label and save .sas7bdat and .xpt files permanently.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name of the input dataset

  *Required:* Yes

**`outlib`**

: Name of the output library

  *Required:* Yes

**`outds`**

: Name of the output dataset

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `&inds`

**`keepvars`**

: List of variables to keep

  *Required:* No

**`sortvars`**

: Sort order for the dataset

  *Required:* No

**`dslbl`**

: Label for the dataset

  *Required:* No

**`xpt`**

: Flag that determines whether to save .xpt file or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xusave(dm,sdtm,outds=dm,keepvars=studyidusubjid...,sortvars=usubjid,dslbl=Demographics,xpt=Y);
```
